nodes.text: "Back in 2019, COVID-19 caused a global pandemic with 5L+ deaths, leaving a deep impact. Now, HMPV has surfaced in India, raising concerns. But as per (Dr.) Atul Goel, DGHS & Director, no need to panic—it’s a respiratory issue. Maintain hygiene, wear masks, wash hands. https://t.co/RfxTkHUqxn
